name: What should I look for when choosing an earthquake retrofit contractor in the Los Angeles area?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing an earthquake retrofit contractor in the Los Angeles area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor, prioritize those with specific experience in seismic retrofitting for homes in the Los Angeles area. Look for proper licensing, insurance, and a strong track record demonstrated by positive client references or case studies. Ensure they provide a detailed scope of work, transparent pricing, and are familiar with local building codes and permitting requirements. A reputable contractor will also be able to explain the retrofit process clearly and answer all your questions thoroughly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with specific seismic retrofitting experience in Los Angeles, proper licensing, insurance, strong references, clear pricing, and knowledge of local codes.
